hero.title: Find any tab, bookmark, or page, without leaving the keyboard.
hero.lede: MiaoMint opens a Spotlight-style palette over any page. Search your open tabs, bookmarks, and history in one field, then jump straight to the result.

tour.title: See what it looks like in use.
tour.lede: Every capture below is the real extension, running over a live page.

slides.title: Unified search
slides.desc: One field for open tabs, bookmarks, history, URLs, and web search, ranked and de-duplicated.

slides.title: Open tabs
slides.desc: Every open tab in one list, with the current tab ranked first.

slides.title: Bookmarks
slides.desc: Type /b to search bookmarks. They load only when you ask, so startup stays fast.

slides.title: History
slides.desc: Type /h to search visited pages without loading your whole history up front.

slides.title: Personalization
slides.desc: Theme, window opacity, and interface language, saved to Chrome sync.

slides.title: Demo
slides.desc: Alt/Opt + M, arrow keys, Enter, Esc — the full open-search-open loop.

features.title: What it does, and how far to trust it.
features.lede: Each capability is labelled by where its data comes from. Anything read from your browser stays in your browser.

items.name: Hybrid search
items.desc: One field queries all three at once and de-duplicates the results, so a page you have open and the same page from last week are one match, not two.

items.name: Keyboard-first
items.desc: Open with a shortcut, move with the arrow keys, open with Enter, dismiss with Esc. Your hands never leave the keys.

items.name: Duplicate cleanup
items.desc: See every duplicated tab in one list, then close the extras in a single action. Nothing is closed without a keypress.

items.name: Smart recommendations
items.desc: Frequent and recent pages surface on their own, ranked by how often and how recently you use them. The ranking is computed on-device.

items.name: Command modes
items.desc: Scope the search with a prefix instead of a menu: bookmarks, history, recommendations, duplicates, or settings.

items.name: Personalization
items.desc: Pick a theme, set the window opacity, and switch the interface language. Preferences sync through Chrome, not through us.

how.title: Open, search, act.
how.lede: Three steps, and the third one is the only one that changes anything on screen.

steps.title: Open
steps.desc: Press Alt/Opt + M on any page. The palette is injected at page load, so it appears without waiting for the page to finish rendering.

steps.title: Search
steps.desc: One field queries open tabs, bookmarks, and history together, de-duplicates them, and ranks the most likely match first.

steps.title: Act
steps.desc: Open the result with Enter, close a tab with Delete, or close every duplicate in one action. Nothing is written anywhere.

split.label: Reads
split.title: Local and offline
split.desc: Tabs, bookmarks, and history are read in your browser's memory. No network call is required to search them.

split.label: Writes
split.title: Nothing is stored
split.desc: There is no backend and no analytics. Your browsing data is never uploaded, and nothing leaves the device.

principles.title: The rules it will not break.

items.title: Nothing leaves your device
items.desc: Tabs, bookmarks, and history are read and searched in memory. There is no backend to send them to.

items.title: No account, no sign-in
items.desc: Install it and use it. No email, no login, no profile.

items.title: Instant, not heavy
items.desc: Injected at page load, with bookmarks and history loaded only when you ask, so it never slows the browser down.

items.title: Free forever
items.desc: Every feature is in the one free extension. No paid tier, no subscription, no upsell.

install.title: Add it in one click.
install.lede: Install from the Chrome Web Store and start searching. No setup, no account, no configuration required.

note.label: Permissions
note.text: MiaoMint reads tabs, bookmarks, and history only to power search. The all-sites permission exists so the palette can be injected into any page you visit — no page content is read beyond showing the search bar.

items.q: How is this different from Chrome's built-in tab search?
items.a: Chrome's tab search only looks at open tabs. MiaoMint searches open tabs, bookmarks, and history in the same field, adds duplicate detection and frequency-based recommendations, and opens from any page with Alt/Opt + M.
Yes. MiaoMint is free to use. There is no paid tier, no subscription, and no account.
None. There is no backend and no analytics. Tabs, bookmarks, and history are processed locally in your browser and never uploaded.

items.q: Why does it need access to all sites?
items.a: The search bar is injected into the page you are on so the shortcut works everywhere. MiaoMint does not read page content beyond displaying the bar.
Yes. Search runs locally, so it works without a connection. Web search fallback uses your default search engine.
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese. You can switch at any time from the settings.
Theme, opacity, and language are stored with chrome.storage.sync, so they can follow you across signed-in Chrome devices.

cta.title: Point it at your tabs and see what you have.
cta.lede: Free, local-only, and read-only until you choose a result.

footer.tagline: Local-first. No backend. One keystroke away.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_text: MiaoMint ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how our Chrome Extension ("MiaoMint") handles your data.
privacy.core_principle: Core Principle: We believe your browsing data belongs to you. MiaoMint is designed to operate locally on your device. We do not collect, store, or transmit your personal data to any external servers.
privacy.tab_info_text: MiaoMint accesses your open tabs' titles and URLs solely to provide the search and navigation functionality. This processing happens entirely within your browser's memory.
privacy.bookmark_info_text: When you use bookmark search (e.g. bookmark mode), MiaoMint reads your browser bookmarks' titles and URLs to provide local search and open-bookmark functionality. Bookmark data is processed locally in your browser and is not transmitted to us.
privacy.history_info_text: When you use history search (e.g. history mode), MiaoMint searches your browsing history to provide local search and open-history functionality. History data is processed locally in your browser and is not transmitted to us.
privacy.search_queries_text: If you choose to run a web search from MiaoMint, your query is passed to your browser's built-in search feature (e.g. `chrome.search.query`) and will be handled by your default search engine according to its own privacy policy. We do not receive or store your search queries.
privacy.user_settings_text: Your preferences (theme, opacity, etc.) are stored using `chrome.storage.sync`. If you have Chrome Sync enabled, these settings may be synchronized across your signed-in Chrome devices by Google as part of the browser's sync feature. You can control this behavior in your browser sync settings.
privacy.keyboard_interactions_text: MiaoMint uses keyboard events to support the command shortcut and in-UI navigation (e.g. Escape, Arrow keys, Enter). These events are not recorded, stored, or sent to us.
privacy.no_remote_collection_text: We do not have any backend servers. We do not use Google Analytics or any third-party tracking scripts within the extension. Your tab and bookmark data is processed locally in your browser and is not transmitted to us.

permissions.all_urls: Read and change all your data on the websites you visit (``): This permission is technically required to inject the MiaoMint search bar (Spotlight-like UI) into every page you visit so you can invoke it with a shortcut. We do not read page content other than to display the search bar.
permissions.tabs: Tabs: Required to list your currently open tabs (title, URL) so you can search and switch between them.
permissions.bookmarks: Bookmarks: Required to list your browser bookmarks (title, URL) so you can search and open them.
permissions.history: History: Required to search your browser history (title, URL) so you can find and open visited pages.
permissions.storage: Storage: Required to save your preferences (theme, opacity, language).
permissions.search: Search: Required to trigger a web search using your browser's default search engine when you choose to do so.
permissions.active_tab: Active Tab: Required to interact with the currently active tab when you invoke the extension (e.g. showing the UI and opening a selected result).

privacy.your_rights_text: Since we do not collect your data, there is no data for us to delete or export upon request. You have full control over the local data stored by the extension:

your_rights_list.item1: You can uninstall the extension to immediately remove all associated local data.
your_rights_list.item2: If you have Chrome Sync enabled, you can disable sync or clear synced data via your browser sync settings.

privacy.changes_text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. If we make significant changes, we will notify you by updating the date at the top of this policy and, where appropriate, through the extension.
privacy.contact_text: If you have questions about this policy, please contact us via the Chrome Web Store support tab.
